rules.note: Direct election, two rounds if no candidate wins an absolute majority. Candidates must be approved by the Guardian Council. A vacancy is filled by the First Vice President (with the Leader's approval) and a new election within 50 days (Article 131), as in 2024.

Four-year term, two rounds. Candidates are vetted by the Guardian Council. Assembly of Experts elections (88 seats; 2006, 2016, 2024) are listed below as kind 'legislative' without a chamber, because the schema has no kind for them; they have no recurrence rule here.

historical.note: Second round 5 May 2000. First election to the enlarged 290-seat Majlis. Bloc totals from the Inter-Parliamentary Union: 2nd of Khordad Front 222, Front of Followers of the Line of the Imam and the Leader 54, independents 14. Nohlen et al. give IIPF and allies 216, CCA and allies 74. Mehdi Karroubi (ACC) became Speaker.
